title: Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM, formerly VMware Workspace ONE (REST API, OAuth client with a read-only role)
readScopes: A Workspace ONE UEM OAuth client (Groups & Settings > Configurations > OAuth Client Management) whose role holds only the REST permission "REST API Devices Read" (REST > Devices, "Enables access to all READ only APIs in Devices collection", Read Only). It reads GET /api/mdm/devices/search (MDM API V3) and GET /api/mdm/devices/{uuid}/security/encryption-status (MDM API V1). WS1_CLIENT_ID and WS1_CLIENT_SECRET; the REST API URL (Groups & Settings > All Settings > System > Advanced > API > REST API, e.g. https://as1234.awmdm.com) is WS1_API_URL and the regional token URL (https://na|emea|apac.uemauth.workspaceone.com/connect/token) is WS1_TOKEN_URL.

checks.title: Each device reports its storage as encrypted
checks.scope: Every device in service, one result per device, from encryption_status of GET /devices/{uuid}/security/encryption-status; a device with no answer is skipped.

checks.title: Each device runs an OS at or above the given minimum version
checks.scope: Every device in service, from operating_system against --workspace-one-min-os for its device_type (macos, windows, ios, android, chromeos, linux or the enum value); without that option the check is skipped once. Vendor support dates are not looked up.

checks.title: Each device has reported to Workspace ONE UEM within the last 14 days
checks.scope: Every device in service, from last_seen ("Time the device last reported any status"); the window is --workspace-one-seen-days.

checks.title: Each device is enrolled
checks.scope: Every device listed, from enrollment_status: ENROLLED passes; DISCOVERED, REGISTERED, ENROLLMENT_IN_PROGRESS, PENDING_AGENT and APP_CATALOG_ONLY fail; retired, unenrolled and wiped devices are skipped.

checks.title: Each device is compliant with its Workspace ONE UEM compliance policies
checks.scope: Every device in service, from compliance_status: COMPLIANT passes; NOT_COMPLIANT, BLOCKED and QUARANTINED fail; pending, not available and unknown states are skipped. A device is only as compliant as the policies assigned to it.

checks.title: No device is reported compromised (jailbroken or rooted)
checks.scope: Every device in service, from compromised_status.
